- **Axle limit:** Svínvetningabraut (Auðkúluvegur to Hringvegur) has a 5-tonne axle weight limit. This is unlikely to matter for a camper van, but check if it is heavy.

All 26 segments are currently GREIDFAERT (easily passable), so there is no blocked road.
